description:
Cast Lumbering Battlement by paying {4}{W}.
When Lumbering Battlement enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Suspension Field to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Suspension Field enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Lumbering Battlement until Suspension Field leaves the battlefield.
Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Abdel Adrian to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Suspension Field and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Suspension Field leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Lumbering Battlement to return to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.
